body:
Hi everyone, here's this week's round of changes on alpha.midjourney.com . The highlight this week is shared folders, a new way to collaborate on Midjourney. Many of these improvements came straight from #alpha-ideas-and-bugs and office hours, so keep your thoughts coming!

🆕🆕🆕 THINKING MODE You can now rerun jobs made with 8.2 (standard and edit) with "thinking.” Midjourney looks at your image, finds where it missed your prompt (wrong objects, layout, anatomy, text) and generates again. This is an early version so we'd love to hear your feedback.

🆕🆕🆕 SHARED FOLDERS We’ve launched better ways for you to create together - folders can now be shared! Invite people by username as Collaborators or Viewers. Collaborators can generate right into the folder and build on each other's work. Viewers can browse the images within the folder. You can also share a folder by link. Keep it private to the people you add, let anyone with the link view it, or open it up so any Midjourney member can contribute. The owner can delete a shared folder for everyone. The images stay in each creator's own history.

One heads-up: sharing doesn't change image privacy. Non-stealth images can still appear on Explore and on profiles, even if you made them inside a private folder. This is also an early version, and we'd love to hear your feedback.

WHAT YOU SAID No more edits stuck on 'Submitting...': stalled submits now fail cleanly within 2 minutes, and jobs that secretly succeeded show up in your feed. The inline editor no longer crashes to the error screen after an edit. Keyboard shortcuts no longer fire underneath an open dialog or zoomed image. Older Firefox versions work again. And catching up on a very long history no longer stalls partway. Clicking the '+N more' pill on an image applies those settings as intended. And Live Style Previews now work on custom styles.

ORGANIZATION IMPROVEMENTS You can pin a folder to the top of your sidebar. Search and Filters on Organize have been moved into the feed's top row where you'd expect them. Deleting a personalization profile gives you an Undo instead of an are-you-sure dialog. The pills you set in a folder stay with it, even across sessions. You can rename a folder in-place easily.

MOODBOARDS Large uploads now happen a few images at a time with a clear progress bar, so adding multiple references no longer stalls.

PROMPT BAR & VIDEO Using --tile with an attached image now tells you they're incompatible. Extend and Loop on video inform you the length cap if you hit it.

POLISH & BUGS Draft mode on V8.1 and V8.2 always makes a 24-image grid, and now the tooltips, hover text, and Try buttons make that clear. The help, billing support, and submit-a-ticket links now take you where they're supposed to. Rare job types show up normally instead of crashing the page. Grid spacing got a cleanup pass. If something's wrong with your account, you now find out plainly. Temporary suspensions come with an Appeal button, and restricted accounts see dimmed controls with an explanation instead of a moderator error.

UP NEXT Edit history that sticks around when you leave and come back. More ways to explore, find, and create styles.

Please keep sharing your feedback with us so we can continue to improve! And, as always, thank you for being part of our community ❤️
